## Description

Pilot agreement with two design-partner clinics: scope (R1 then R2), duration, support, data processing agreement, feedback commitments, baseline-measurement consent, exit terms.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Two signed pilot agreements including DPA are on file before production tenants are created.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each clinic names an owner contact and a receptionist champion.
- [ ] **AC3.** Pilot start dates are scheduled with each clinic (considering the year-end holiday).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
